# authwise_access_permissions (Data Source)

A permission in an audience's Access catalog. The id is the permission's own name, such as `guardcontrol.tenants.get`. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `audience_id` (String) Parent identifier `audience_id`; overrides the provider default.
- `issuer_id` (String) Parent identifier `issuer_id`; overrides the provider default.
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `access_permissions` (Attributes List) Every access_permission under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_permissions))

<a id="nestedatt--access_permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_permissions`

Read-Only:

- `access_permission_id` (String) Caller-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`.
- `description` (String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
- `resource_type` (String)
- `service` (String)
